description: This file defines an interface IGrainActivator for creating and disposing grain instances within the Orleans runtime. It specifies methods for instantiating grain objects based on a grain context and for cleaning up those instances.

classes.name: IGrainActivator
classes.description: An interface for creating and disposing grain instances in Orleans, with methods CreateInstance and DisposeInstance.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new grain instance for a given grain context.

methods.name: DisposeInstance
methods.description: Disposes of a grain instance associated with a specific grain context.
